description: Verify that Server-reboot recovery — DUT renews TCP after lower-sid OfferService
approach:
[Objective]
After a simulated server reboot (signalled by an OfferService with a lower SD session_id), DUT must reset its session view and renew the TCP handshake.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService (initial sid).
2. Tester ⇄ DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with TCP option + handshake.
3. Tester → DUT: simulated reboot OfferService (lower sid).
4. Observation: DUT renews TCP handshake.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT renewed TCP after reboot signal — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_first_subscribe: No DUT Subscribe with TCP option within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_renewed_handshake: DUT did not renew TCP connection after simulated reboot
